Name: Go To Sleep
Author: TheAshie
Description:
Stardew Valley reminds me of Harvest Moon in so many ways, so I decided to add a mechanic from Harvest Moon to Stardew Valley: Oversleeping!

Go To Sleep is for Stardew Valley 1.3 Beta, and should be compatible with the latest SMAPI version.

Now, when you sleep, there's a small chance you'll oversleep, waking up anywhere from 6AM to 9AM.

Thanks to the great folks in the Stardew Valley Discord for their help.

Good News Everyone! There are now not one, but TWO versions of this mod!

The "Late Night Oversleeping" version penalizes you for going to bed after 12AM, or for Passing Out. Better get in bed quick!

The "Oversleep Any Time" version is the basic version, which just gives a chance to oversleep no matter what time you go to bed. Don't forget to set your alarms, Farmer!

Thank you all for enjoying my mod!
